paths.description: Entry, age assurance, search and homepage listing; represents global chrome and the principal browse journey.
Women category listing; represents category and filtered-result templates.
A current advertisement detail; represents detail, media and contact surfaces.

Sign-in/registration surface; represents account forms and authentication.
Offers index; represents the secondary marketplace template.
Intentional invalid route; tests HTTP/error recovery presentation.

findings.summary: Dark preference does not change the light-only interface
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is visually identical to the default and the page exposes no dark-theme CSS signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and retint surfaces/text with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: High-contrast support is incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails color contrast; the probe found no prefers-contrast/forced-colors rule while examples include #999 on #fff at 2.84:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors/prefers-contrast treatments and meet WCAG contrast minimums.

findings.summary: Route and state swaps do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: The feature probe found startViewTransition available but no authored view-transition CSS or use.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance meaningful route/state changes with View Transitions and reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Carousel and disclosure behavior relies on legacy scripted widgets
findings.evidence: DOM/HAR evidence shows Owl Carousel, lightbox, jQuery mousewheel and custom data-mb controls, with no scroll-snap or platform gesture primitive.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll snap/overscroll and native disclosure primitives, retaining lightweight fallbacks.

findings.summary: Long-page chrome provides no scroll-state feedback
findings.evidence: The 5,855px mobile page has static chrome; CSS probes found no scroll timeline or scroll-state/container behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll progress or responsive sticky-header state using declarative CSS.

findings.summary: Menus and overlays use manually wired positioning
findings.evidence: The page has custom data-mb dropdowns but no anchor-name/position-anchor CSS and no popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use Popover plus CSS Anchor Positioning with position-try fallbacks for transient menus.

findings.summary: Navigation changes lack focus/attention cues
findings.evidence: The probe found no View Transition, scroll marker, highlight, or visible focus outline on the first focused control.
findings.suggestedFix: Move focus intentionally and add visible directional/highlight cues after navigation.

findings.summary: The age gate and rich controls are custom div/script widgets
findings.evidence: The full-screen age gate is a div with manual jQuery dismissal; the DOM has no dialog, popover or details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a modal dialog for age assurance and native popover/details for transient controls, preserving required consent behavior.

findings.summary: Advertising and controls crowd the core browse content
findings.evidence: The full page combines dense filters, 297 hash-action links, multiple animated banners and repeated recommendation rails around the listings.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer secondary filters/ads, simplify repeated chrome, and keep the listing/search task dominant.

findings.summary: Responsiveness is viewport-only rather than component-aware
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container usage despite cards and controls being reused in several widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reusable cards, filters and header modules.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch target treatment are insufficient
findings.evidence: The focused anchor computed to outline none 0px; Lighthouse reports 20px-high city links failing target size.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styles and at least 24px targets/spacing, preferably 44px for primary touch actions.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP is outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.4s (performance 0.90); the direct desktop trace was faster at 1.65s, showing a mobile-path problem.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP asset, cut render blocking and defer below-fold media.

findings.summary: Late content can shift because image space is not reserved
findings.evidence: Mobile layout observed CLS 0.113 and the image audit found all 100 images missing width/height.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio for every image and reserve dynamic slots.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is heavy and render-blocked
findings.evidence: HAR records 141 requests/3.77MB, five parser-blocking stylesheets and legacy parser-inserted scripts; Lighthouse estimates 760ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline critical CSS, defer noncritical scripts/styles, optimize fonts and improve cache lifetimes.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable legacy and unused code
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 20KiB unused JS, 31KiB unused CSS and 15KiB legacy-JS savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused Bootstrap/select plugins, split per-template code and ship a modern bundle.

findings.summary: Controls, links, fields and images lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails button-name, link-name and image-alt; the probe finds unlabeled search selects and login fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Give icon controls accessible names, associate visible labels, and add meaningful or empty alt as appropriate.

findings.summary: Important UI text fails minimum contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 1.91:1 search-header text and 2.84:1 select text against their backgrounds.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust the palette to at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text/essential UI.

findings.summary: Focus indication is absent and landmarks are incomplete
findings.evidence: The first focusable control has outline none; the probe found headers/footers but no explicit main/nav landmarks in its landmark list.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a main landmark, labelled navigation and consistent visible :focus-visible treatment.

findings.summary: The viewport disables user zoom and targets are too small
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails meta-viewport because user-scalable=no/maximum-scale=1 and fails target-size for 20px-high links.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove zoom restrictions and enlarge/space interactive targets.

findings.summary: The document runs in quirks mode and image delivery is unsound
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no HTML doctype; all 100 audited images lack dimensions, 39 are oversized and 43 use legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <!doctype html>, intrinsic image dimensions, responsive sources and modern formats.

findings.summary: Some anchors are not crawlable and the viewport is not mobile-friendly
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails crawlable-anchors and meta-viewport; the DOM contains 297 href=# action links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons for actions, real URLs for navigation, and a zoom-safe viewport declaration.

findings.summary: Canonical and localized indexing signals are incomplete
findings.evidence: The homepage is indexable and sitemap-backed, but the DOM probe found no canonical and no captured hreflang links despite eight language variants.
findings.suggestedFix: Add self-referencing canonical and reciprocal hreflang/x-default links across localized hosts.

findings.summary: Session transport policy is weakened by cookie and CSP gaps
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff are present, but CSP is missing; escortsession is not Secure or HttpOnly and uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure, HttpOnly and appropriate SameSite on session cookies and deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP.

findings.summary: Third-party delivery is broad and consent is bundled into entry
findings.evidence: The page contacts seven third-party origins and transfers 2.89MB cross-origin by harness classification; entry states that proceeding accepts cookies without granular choices.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize vendors, self-host necessary assets, disclose purposes and offer granular consent before nonessential collection.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only and blocks autofill
findings.evidence: No permission prompt fires on load, but login has no WebAuthn/passkey path and sets autocomplete=off on username/password.
findings.suggestedFix: Enable standards-based autofill and add passkeys/WebAuthn as a phishing-resistant option.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defenses are absent
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows no CSP, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy, although HSTS and SAMEORIGIN framing protection are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strict Referrer-Policy, least-privilege Permissions-Policy and CSP frame-ancestors/Trusted Types where feasible.

findings.summary: Localized hosts do not have robust bidirectional layout foundations
findings.evidence: html lang=pl is correct, but the stylesheet probe counts 528 physical-direction rules versus 114 logical-property rules and no dir attribute.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction explicitly where needed and migrate layout rules to logical properties for translation/bidi resilience.

findings.summary: Cookie agreement is coupled to mandatory age entry
findings.evidence: The blocking gate says continuing expresses cookie consent and offers only Enter or leave the site, with no reject/manage choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Separate necessary age assurance from optional cookie consent and provide equally clear accept/reject/manage controls.

findings.summary: Forms lack programmatic labels and rely on opaque required behavior
findings.evidence: Login requires username/password but both are placeholder-only, have no associated labels and expose no initial accessible error region.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate labels, validate after interaction, focus/announce an error summary and preserve entered values.

findings.summary: Sign-in input assistance is deliberately disabled
findings.evidence: Both username and password use autocomplete=off instead of username/current-password, and fields have no labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Use correct autocomplete tokens and stable labelled fields so password managers and autofill work.

findings.summary: Images and animated banners waste substantial bandwidth
findings.evidence: Image audit: 39 oversized, 98 below-fold not lazy, 60 without srcset and 43 legacy-format; Lighthouse estimates 2.13MB image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Convert GIF banners to efficient video, resize assets, add srcset/sizes and lazy-load below-fold media.

findings.summary: Legacy widgets and unused bundles perform avoidable work
findings.evidence: The page loads 27 scripts/12 styles; Lighthouse identifies heavily unused Bootstrap CSS/JS and legacy transforms.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused plugins, conditionally load template features and pause nonessential work when hidden.

findings.summary: Animated media and third-party bytes are disproportionate
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 3.08MB to images and 2.89MB to cross-origin delivery; individual GIF banners transfer up to 856KB in this capture.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a media/third-party budget, replace GIFs, defer ads and self-host only the assets that provide clear value.

Separate age assurance from optional cookie consent and harden session/security policy
Add doctype, image dimensions, canonical/hreflang and crawlable action semantics
Adopt semantic dialog/popover and lightweight modern interaction primitives
Add component queries, logical properties and user-preference theming
